snippet.title: Groundwork Simulator – Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5306540/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=overview

Dig anywhere. Build your operation. Turn dirt into gold.
Take a deeper look at Groundwork Simulator, an open-world heavy machinery simulator where every bucket changes the landscape. This gameplay overview shows how you turn untouched ground into a working operation, from your first excavation to processing material for gold.

Get behind the controls of excavators, wheel loaders, bulldozers and trucks. Reshape hillsides, clear trees and haul material across your worksite. Drill to locate valuable deposits, set up your washing equipment and connect the pumps, hoses and water systems that keep everything running.

Build your company at your own pace or share the workload with friends in co-op for up to 4 players.

• Dig anywhere and reshape the entire map
• Operate heavy machinery with realistic excavation physics
• Clear trees and make your own path
• Drill for deposits and process material for gold
• Build and manage pumps, hoses and water systems
• Transport your equipment between worksites
• Grow your company, solo or with friends  

Follow Groundwork Simulator:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/groundworksimulator/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/Groundwork-Simulator/61592264177927/
Website: http://groundworksimulator.com

#GroundworkSimulator #SimulationGames #HeavyMachinery
